station_name: MERCED RIVER AT POHONO BRIDGE, NEAR YOSEMITE, CALIF.
notes: Sampled table = daily discharge grid plus the PEAK DISCHARGE (BASE, 2,900 CFS) block below it. Daily values counted by month: 31+30+31+31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30 = 365. Peak block: 3 peaks (5-16, 5-26, 6-13), each with gage height and discharge = 6 values (times not counted). Summary: 5 foot rows x 12 months = 60, plus CAL YR and WTR YR lines 5 each = 10. Other location text: in Yosemite National Park, on left bank 150 ft upstream from Pohono Bridge, 0.4 mile upstream from Artist Creek, 4.8 miles southwest of Yosemite National Park headquarters.
